name: Qiru · Gremlet #24
description:
A qilin foal with jade scales and a cloud-puff tail. Little flowers bloom where it steps.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Qiru in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
